description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy of different models as a function of the number of demonstrations, with the x-axis labeled "#Demonstrations" ranging from 0 to 1500 in increments of 250, and the y-axis labeled "Accuracy" ranging from 45 to 55. The plot compares four models: Squared Exponential, Tash, ELL, and LLAMA-2-chat-7B. The Squared Exponential model, represented by a solid black line with circular markers, starts at an accuracy of approximately 52.5 and increases to about 56.5, remaining relatively stable after 250 demonstrations. The Tash model, shown as a solid blue line with circular markers, begins at around 48.5 and slightly decreases to approximately 47.5, maintaining a relatively flat trend. The ELL model, depicted by a solid purple line with circular markers, starts at about 47.5 and remains nearly constant, showing minimal change across the number of demonstrations. The LLAMA-2-chat-7B model, indicated by a dashed pink line with circular markers, starts at approximately 47.5 and remains flat, with a slight increase to about 48.5 at 1500 demonstrations. The legend in the top right corner identifies each model with its corresponding line style and color.
